courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Let's dive into that persistent state part which I mentioned in the last module as well
and with that, I simply mean let's make sure that we also save data on a back-end, on a server running
in the web, not on our local device
and of course that we don't just save data there but that we can also fetch it from there.
So in this module, we'll have a brief look at how we actually connect an Ionic app to a back-end, how
that works technically or how we implement that and then we'll simply build stuff. We'll work on the app
and we'll make sure that we store all the places we create on the back-end, that we fetch the places from
there and that we also store our bookings there.
